title: Data Compression in Transmission Electron Microscopy
content: Electron microscopy (EM) has become an essential tool in various fields, including materials science, biology, and nanotechnology. The increasing resolution and size of EM images have led to a growing need for efficient compression algorithms to reduce storage and transmission costs. However, the complexity of EM images, which is characterized by their unique structural and textual features, poses a significant challenge to compression. In this study, Shannon entropy is used as a metric to quantify the level of complexity in EM images as seen in Figure 1 [1]. The application of Shannon entropy can be used to evaluate the efficacy of various compression algorithms than can be used in this field.
